canonical_statement: The physical world, including humanity, flora, fauna, and geography, is the product of deliberate divine creation.

attributions.surface_quote: He formed mankind... The beasts of the field... he created.

canonical_statement: The act of naming an entity or feature is an essential component of its creation and ontological establishment.

attributions.surface_quote: Their names he declared in goodly fashion.

canonical_statement: Ritual purification and incantation are effective mechanisms for aligning human existence with divine decrees.

attributions.surface_quote: By the incantation of Marduk... may thy decree be accomplished for ever!
